verdict.rationale: incident.io's own marketing says it offers "public and private Status Pages", so private status pages are a first-party capability. Beyond that single statement, the pack documents nothing on how access is controlled or which audiences are supported. Missing for 10: documented access-control mechanisms (SSO/auth, allowlists), customer-specific audience pages, employee-only/internal page configuration, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can run private or internal status pages with access control for customer-specific or employee-only audiences

citations.quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.
